title: Emergency Accommodation Framework (DN677298)
buyer: Bristol City Council / South Gloucestershire Council
description: Open framework / DPS for emergency accommodation, including spot purchases and block contracts. New suppliers can apply during its life.
deadline: Current DPS round ends 3 Dec 2027, 20:00. Initial 2023 deadline is not the current admission deadline.
eligibility: Accommodation for families, singles and couples; landlord/provider manages housing, repairs, safety certification and safeguarding. Council inspection before use.
value_term: £96m framework-wide, not guaranteed income. Council advert/register: 4 Dec 2023 to 3 Dec 2027, optional extensions subject to buyer confirmation.
next_step: Open the live council advert, check application documents and supplier requirements, then apply through ProContract.

title: Private Renting Team property leasing
description: Direct landlord supply/leasing route, not a competitive tender. Council considers different property types and may consider locations outside Bristol.
deadline: No fixed deadline published; confirm availability with the Private Renting Team.
eligibility: Rental safety regulations, certificates and condition checked on a council visit. Landlord manages the property or appoints an agent.
value_term: Leasing contracts: 2 years. Pricing and detailed risk allocation to be agreed. Tenant-finding incentives are not automatically leasing terms.
next_step: Contact private.renting@bristol.gov.uk through the official enquiry route; ask for current leasing terms and property demand.

title: Supported Temporary Accommodation Framework (DN792893)
description: Watchlist, not a current invitation. Initial procurement has closed and an award notice was published. Next tender notice estimated 1 Jan 2027, not confirmed open admission.
eligibility: Partner Registered Providers; family self-contained units or supported family/single accommodation. Lot-specific unit sizes, staffing and shared-entrance limits apply.
value_term: £26,730,931 excluding VAT across lots. 1 Jul 2026 to 30 Jun 2031, possible extensions to 2034.
next_step: Monitor the official procurement for reopening; do not submit as a presently open tender.

title: Private Sector Leasing scheme
buyer: City of Edinburgh Council / Link C~urb
description: Council-linked property leasing route for households needing housing. Operator is recruiting landlords; this is not a competitive tender.
deadline: No fixed deadline published. Confirm current acceptance and property valuation with C~urb.
eligibility: Private landlords; landlord registration, repairing standards, gas/fire safety and HMO licence where applicable. Operator acceptance and inspection required.
value_term: Operator offers 3 or 5 years, quarterly rent in advance, no management fee; guaranteed rent under scheme terms. No property-specific rate published.
next_step: Ask psllandlord@curb.scot or 0330 303 0087 for valuation, demand and full lease obligations.

title: Long-term temporary-accommodation leasing
description: Operating supply route last reported in the council update dated 7 Jan 2026. Current admission is not verified, so this is a buyer-enquiry lead, not a live bid.
deadline: No application deadline evidenced; current intake must be confirmed.
eligibility: Privately sourced properties inside Manchester city boundaries. Bedroom, EPC and supplier criteria not specified in the cited report.
value_term: Individual leases: 10 years + 1 day. Rent / supplier contract value unpublished. 350 properties then on scheme; figures are last reported, not current.
next_step: Ask council report contacts nicola.rea@manchester.gov.uk or Rob.McCartney@manchester.gov.uk whether intake is open and request specification.
